notes: Annotated typescript, manuscript page 4 and archive sheet number 12 (comment only). There are three displayed blocks, with the b′ cohomology map and final proof equalities remaining within their prose blocks. No new title, date, total page count, independent drawing or diagram occurs.

Condition b) requires the action of every indicated codimension-n correspondence from a proper smooth connected curve to land in im(i*). The motivic gloss is expressly qualified: “Si on admet le yoga des motifs, justifiable par les” followed by “conjectures standard”. The pen insertion plus grand modifies morceau in the assertion about the level-1 part of a motive realizing Coker i*. This remains an unproved source interpretation.

The conclusion decomposes an algebraically trivial z as i*(z′)+z″, with z′ algebraically trivial and z″ a family difference of an inserted Q-cycle whose induced cohomological map is zero. The proof invokes a) and b), chooses a realizing correspondence Z′ and subtracts its pullback. Its printed composition is (iv)Z=i(vZ), without stars on i; neither stars nor omitted coefficients/twists are supplied from expected mathematics.

All three readers checked only the local linear-map cancellation: if A v is the identity on im(A) and im(T) is contained in im(A), then T−AvT=0. R3 additionally checked the additive fibre-difference identity under evaluation/pullback compatibility. These events do not prove existence of the cycles/maps or the motivic gloss. The earlier uncertain reverse-map label is not used to overwrite the clear v printed on this page.

The first displayed expression visibly has a closing parenthesis after C followed by the coefficient and two later closes. Its failure to parse led to a crop, which confirmed the punctuation; H’s comma repair is rejected. Both left Qs overwrite old Zs, including the later Z omitted by both witnesses. The four second-parameter indices are o-shaped and share the first occurrence’s o/0 doubt.

The ink resolves cetté, hypthèse, cancelled e courbe and cancelled de. Five x-out cells following cetté do not recover a whole old même. The cancelled Cx prefix contains a visible x whose old-product versus cancellation role remains undetermined. The final z′/Z′ overprint is retained without an invented sequence of old and new letters.

The main crop resolves the short underline literally within et: the rule starts under t and extends through un, encoded e followed by underlined t un. The Q- prefix has regular typed forms, with a separate pen placement guide. The last insertion has a grave-shaped accent, so règulier is primary with régulier alternative; its terminal hook is part of the guide, not a comma.

Section 3 begins the relative setup for proper smooth X and Y over S with the inserted regularity condition and connexe, followed by i:Y→X. It does not complete a new relative assertion on this page. H’s global machine-ell and emphasis conventions are credited; actual underline scope, source layer, omitted cancellations, source x characters and final-equation placement are recorded separately.
